solver_contract.claim_boundary: Execution/interface and channel-independence control only; not a SAT/H(s)H physical validation and not a dynamic transport/holonomy result.

units_dimensions.radius: same benchmark length unit as centers

assumptions: equilateral center fixture in the x-y plane embedded in R4
F2 x-w rotation is supplied as an independent frame channel and is not an input to the Three-Spheres carrier reconstruction
expected_invariants: Three-Spheres carrier result is invariant under the F2-only x-w frame perturbation
G = 2/3 for the equilateral radius-1 control
static relative-frame loop telescopes to identity within floating tolerance
failure_conditions: Three-Spheres carrier output changes under frame-only perturbation
analytic G or carrier-radius control fails outside declared tolerance
numerical certification is not CERTIFIED for the regular equilateral fixture
visual diagnostic implies that its x-y projection displays the hidden x-w frame rotation

visual_contract.projection: x-y control-plane projection of the three equal-radius sphere cross-sections and reconstructed carrier center
visual_contract.question_for_nathan: Does this projected equilateral Three-Spheres control depict the intended carrier fixture? The x-w frame perturbation should be invisible in this solver view.
